description: Abstract class defining an interface for reading shuffle files and RDD blocks in Apache Spark, including methods for diagnosing corruption, fetching blocks, pushing blocks, and managing shuffle merge metadata.

classes.name: BlockStoreClient
classes.description: Abstract class providing methods for interacting with shuffle files and RDD blocks in Spark.

methods.name: diagnoseCorruption
methods.description: Sends a request to diagnose the cause of a corrupted shuffle block on a remote node.

methods.name: fetchBlocks
methods.description: Abstract method to fetch a sequence of blocks asynchronously from a remote node.

methods.name: shuffleMetrics
methods.description: Returns shuffle-related metrics; defaults to empty metrics.

methods.name: getHostLocalDirs
methods.description: Requests local disk directories for executors on the same host.

methods.name: pushBlocks
methods.description: Pushes a sequence of shuffle blocks to a remote node (unsupported in base class).

methods.name: finalizeShuffleMerge
methods.description: Notifies shuffle service to finalize shuffle merge (unsupported in base class).

methods.name: getMergedBlockMeta
methods.description: Retrieves meta information of a merged block from remote shuffle service (unsupported in base class).

methods.name: removeShuffleMerge
methods.description: Removes shuffle merge data from shuffle services (unsupported in base class).
